title: Softness Under Fire
north_star: A soft illustrated archive of Aachu and Zuv's love, chaos, culture, and tiny rituals.

golden_theme_contract.first_principles_rule: Before submitting or scoring any new carousel idea, use these source files as the first-principles explanation of why the gold carousel worked: universal anti-ideal -> concrete Aachu proof -> Zuv steady response -> tender acceptance thesis.
golden_theme_contract.rule: Every carousel must start from a universal relationship truth, then prove it through Aachu/Zuv specifics. Photos, places, outfits, and objects are evidence, not the premise.
hard_fail_if: The concept is primarily about an object, outfit, location, or photo aesthetic.
A stranger could not send the carousel to a partner without knowing the private photo context.
Aachu's expressive role is missing or mocked.
Zuv's calm role is passive, absent, or treated as background.
The concept is mostly about taking photos, looking beautiful, glowing, or waiting for one more picture without a deeper relationship tension.
One partner's role is only looking good while the other waits or holds things.
The final thesis is generic romance without a concrete proof trail.
default_five_slide_map: Universal hook: one swipe-stopping relationship truth.
Aachu-specific reveal: her version of the truth.
Concrete proof: a drawable behavior, object, or ritual from the reference material.
Zuv role: what his calm, patience, care, or choice does emotionally.
Save/share thesis: the tender truth underneath the joke.
caption_formula: Open with the universal relationship truth.
Show the couple-specific behavior, care, posture, object, or rhythm in the middle; name Aachu/Zuv only when natural.
End with a soft send/save-worthy thesis.

human_truth: Aachu's spicy tone is not the opposite of softness; it is often hurt, worry, and affection trying to protect itself, and Zuv's active love is hearing the feeling underneath before the moment becomes a fight.
emotional_arc: gentleness anti-ideal -> Aachu's don't-touch-me sleeve proof -> be-safe warning proof -> Zuv hears the hurt underneath -> softness-under-fire thesis
source_story_summary: Selected concept from the Golden Theme tournament: He didn't marry someone who says everything gently. Aachu loves physical affection, says be safe from the bottom of her heart, and sometimes her spicy attitude is hurt asking to be understood. Zuv learns to hear the hurt underneath and comes closer gently. Final thesis: Maybe love is softness under fire.
visual_style: Create a complete publishable @a.storyof.two social slide in the established Aachu/Zuv illustrated carousel look: soft hand-drawn flat vector warmth with desi storybook texture. Treat the first supplied style references as canonical character-model sheets: preserve the same recurring caricature faces, proportions, hair shapes, expressive eyes, beard/brow structure, handwritten lettering, warm paper texture, and soft desi storybook linework from the accepted earlier carousels. Use Product Unshipped-like simplicity adapted for a desi love story, but do not reinterpret the couple into a new generic illustration style. Use the provided identity and style references to create recurring illustrated versions of Aachu/Anchal and Zuv/Himanshu, not generic stock characters. Keep warm off-white paper, imperfect black outlines, slightly uneven strokes, matte muted colors, generous breathing room, expressive faces, detailed-but-soft Indian outfits when story-relevant, and one clear visual idea. Render the exact slide copy as handwritten-style black text inside the artwork, and add the tiny low-contrast handwritten brandmark '@a.storyof.two' at bottom-right as part of the generated image.
target_voice: Aachu/Zuv archive voice: warm, specific, playful underneath the tenderness

concept_selection.source: Golden Theme variant tournament against Calm Enough For Your Chaos first principles.
concept_selection.selector_verdict: Winner converts the screenshot from a generic girl-trait list into a gold-theme love story: the universal tension is not saying love gently when hurt, Aachu's proof is be-safe intensity and contradictory closeness, Zuv's role is hearing the hurt underneath, and the payoff is specific enough to save or send.
concept_selection.calm_enough_for_chaos_alignment: Preserves the gold machine by turning Aachu's expressive edge into lovable softness only because Zuv responds with active patience instead of reacting to the surface tone.
final_public_slide_copy_direction: He didn't marry someone who says everything gently.
"Don't touch me" still held his sleeve.
"Be safe" came out like a warning.
So he heard the hurt underneath.
Maybe love is softness under fire.

candidates.name: Softness Under Fire
candidates.universal_truth: Some people do not say love gently when they are hurt.
candidates.aachu_specific_spark: Aachu's spice, be-safe warnings, and sudden need for closeness are all softness trying not to look soft.
candidates.concrete_proof: She says don't touch me while still holding his sleeve, and be safe lands like a warning because it is love.
candidates.zuv_role: Zuv hears the hurt underneath and comes closer gently instead of arguing with the tone.
candidates.tender_thesis: Maybe love is softness under fire.

candidates.name: The Warning Was Love
candidates.universal_truth: A be-safe message can carry more feeling than a full love letter.
candidates.aachu_specific_spark: Aachu says be safe with protective intensity instead of soft wording.
candidates.concrete_proof: Phone glow, short message, and Zuv reading the worry behind the warning.
candidates.zuv_role: He receives the worry as care, not control.
candidates.tender_thesis: Maybe love is hearing the care inside the warning.

candidates.name: The Attitude Was A Bandage
candidates.universal_truth: Sometimes attitude is the cover a soft heart uses when it is hurt.
candidates.aachu_specific_spark: Aachu's spicy tone is a shield for wanting to be understood.
candidates.concrete_proof: Turned-away face, hand still reaching, and Zuv stepping closer without a lecture.
candidates.zuv_role: He treats the tone as a clue, not the whole truth.
candidates.tender_thesis: Maybe love is not reacting to the shield.

candidates.name: Don't Touch Me, Stay Close
candidates.universal_truth: Some people ask for space while their hand asks for closeness.
candidates.aachu_specific_spark: Aachu's contradiction is visible: dramatic words, soft body language.
candidates.concrete_proof: One sleeve held, one face turned away, one patient hand waiting.
candidates.zuv_role: Zuv reads the body-language request and does not make her explain the contradiction.
candidates.tender_thesis: Maybe love is understanding the almost-said thing.

candidates.name: Soft Hearts Sound Spicy
candidates.universal_truth: The softest people are not always soft-spoken.
candidates.aachu_specific_spark: Aachu's lover-girl heart arrives with a spicy little attitude.
candidates.concrete_proof: A dramatic look, a protective be-safe line, and the hand that still wants contact.
candidates.zuv_role: Zuv loves the softness without asking her to remove the spice.
candidates.tender_thesis: Maybe love is keeping both parts.

candidates.name: She Loves Loudly
candidates.universal_truth: Some love is not calm, but it is deeply sincere.
candidates.aachu_specific_spark: Aachu loves through affection, worry, and the occasional dramatic warning.
candidates.concrete_proof: Cuddling, be safe, and missing her become one emotional pattern.
candidates.zuv_role: Zuv accepts the volume as part of the love.
candidates.tender_thesis: Maybe love is learning someone's volume.
